title: Build emotion and cartoon style image transformation website

requirements.text: Create an image upload interface that accepts person photos in common formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP) with drag-and-drop support and file size validation
acceptanceCriteria: Users can drag and drop image files onto the upload area
Users can click to browse and select image files
Supported formats are validated (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
File size limits are enforced and displayed to users
Preview of uploaded image is shown before processing

requirements.text: Implement emotion transformation selector allowing users to choose target emotions: happy, sad, surprised, angry, neutral
acceptanceCriteria: Display clear emotion options with representative icons or labels
Allow single emotion selection at a time
Visual feedback shows which emotion is currently selected
Selection persists during the transformation process

requirements.text: Implement cartoon style selector with options including: Ghibli-style, classic cartoon, anime, comic book, and watercolor styles
acceptanceCriteria: Display all available cartoon styles with visual examples or descriptions
Allow single style selection at a time
Ghibli-style option is prominently featured
Visual feedback indicates the currently selected style

requirements.text: Create backend endpoint to store uploaded person images and track transformation requests with user sessions
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint accepts image uploads with metadata
Images are stored securely with unique identifiers
Transformation requests are tracked per session
Error handling for invalid uploads or storage failures

requirements.text: Build processing workflow that applies emotion transformation to the uploaded image based on user selection
acceptanceCriteria: Backend receives emotion selection parameter
Image processing applies selected emotion transformation
Transformed image maintains original resolution and quality
Processing status is communicated to frontend

requirements.text: Build processing workflow that applies cartoon style transformation to the emotion-adjusted image based on user selection
acceptanceCriteria: Backend receives cartoon style selection parameter
Style transformation is applied to emotion-adjusted image
Each style produces visually distinct results
Ghibli-style transformation captures characteristic soft colors and hand-drawn aesthetics

requirements.text: Display transformed images with side-by-side comparison view showing original, emotion-adjusted, and final cartoon-styled versions
acceptanceCriteria: Three images displayed clearly: original, intermediate, and final
Responsive layout adapts to different screen sizes
Labels identify each stage of transformation
High-quality image rendering without compression artifacts

requirements.text: Implement download functionality allowing users to save the final transformed image to their device
acceptanceCriteria: Download button is clearly visible and accessible
Downloaded image maintains full quality and resolution
File is saved with descriptive naming convention
Download works across different browsers and devices

requirements.text: Add loading states and progress indicators during image upload and transformation processing
acceptanceCriteria: Upload progress is visually indicated
Processing stages are communicated to users
Loading animations prevent perceived delays
Users understand the current step in the workflow

requirements.text: Design a visually cohesive interface with a creative artistic theme that emphasizes transformation and creativity, using warm, inviting colors and playful typography that reflects the fun, artistic nature of image manipulation
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette uses warm, inviting tones that avoid standard blue/purple combinations
Typography is playful yet readable, supporting the creative theme
Layout emphasizes the transformation journey from upload to final result
Visual style is consistently applied across all components and pages

constraints: Use React with TypeScript for frontend implementation
Use Motoko for backend implementation with single-actor architecture
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, hooks/useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui
Store generated transformation images as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated
nonGoals: Batch processing of multiple images simultaneously
Advanced editing tools beyond emotion and style transformation
